selection: best macro-F1 within the proposed 24-configuration grid

afinn.note: AFINN is an English-only lexicon; Tagalog/Taglish words are unknown to it, so it under-performs on this dataset.

afinn_tagalog.note: AFINN plus the Chen & Skiena (2014) Tagalog lexicon, used unedited (+1 positive / -1 negative word). The Tagalog list is machine-built and noisy (e.g. 'pagkain' = positive, 'din' = negative).
